In [[algebraic geometry]], the '''syntomic topology''' is a [[Grothendieck topology]] introduced by {{harvtxt|Fontaine|Messing|1987}}.

[[Barry Mazur|Mazur]] defined a [[morphism]] to be '''syntomic''' if it is [[flat morphism|flat]] and locally a complete intersection.  The syntomic topology is generated by surjective syntomic morphisms of [[affine scheme]]s.
